latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Kiss — AI-powered editing for romantic video scenes.

- Instantly edit and export 1080p romantic scene clips by describing desired results in plain language.
- No timeline dragging or technical export settings; just upload and specify edits (e.g., "cut to the kiss moment," "add slow motion," "add music fade").
- Quick setup process: automatic token retrieval and connection to cloud GPU editing API.
- Supports a wide range of video, image, and audio formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac) up to 500MB.
- Real-time session state, credit balance, and export actions handled via simple commands.
- Summarizes results and guides users through editing workflows—optimized for both quick single edits and iterative/batch processing.
